items.t: Police in South Carolina close Hayden Panettiere death investigation with no charges
items.x: The investigation into the death of Hayden Panettiere has been closed by police in Greenville, South Carolina

items.t: ‘It’s big’: Astronomers make startling discovery of a possible dwarf planet beyond Pluto
items.x: Astronomers using the world's largest telescope have spotted a new dwarf planet candidate in our solar system, beyond the orbit of Pluto.

items.t: Man accused of hit-and-run on Cape Coral canal marker that caused $1,000 in damage
items.x: A man was arrested after officers with the Cape Coral Police Department say he hit a canal marker and drove away.

items.t: Young entrepreneur gives Cape Coral single mom a free car detail, finds his purpose
items.x: A 20-year-old entrepreneur gives one free car detail a month, including for a Cape Coral single mom whose son has autism, and says helping others is his purpose.

items.t: Wendy's, struggling with beef prices and growing competition, gets a buyout offer
items.x: Wendy’s shares jumped more than 14% on Wednesday after a noted investor made an offer to buy the chain, which has been struggling with high beef prices, aging stores.

items.t: Ave Maria pickleball dispute leads to arrest after woman shoved, slow cooker grabbed, deputies say
items.x: Deputies say an Ave Maria man shoved a woman during a pickleball disagreement, then grabbed a slow cooker and advanced toward her.

items.t: Cape Coral man finds hundreds of honeybees around his pontoon boat's steering wheel
items.x: After traveling, Duncan Amesbury returned and checked on his pontoon boat in Cape Coral, only to find hundreds of honeybees clustered around the steering wheel and ignition.

items.t: Experts debunk claim that voting machines in Cook County, Illinois, are 'rigged'
items.x: Cook County election officials clarify that voting machines do not display candidate popularity, explaining that notifications are related to undervoting as required by federal election laws.

items.t: Man faces attempted murder charges in Cape Coral road rage shooting that left 2 injured
items.x: The suspect in the road rage shooting incident on Santa Barbara Boulevard in Cape Coral was arrested in Lehigh Acres.

items.t: Casey Askar denies wage and housing claims, lays out priorities in Florida's new District 22 race
items.x: Republican candidate Casey Askar responded to allegations from his opponent, shared his campaign goals, and discussed key issues like cost of living, Social Security, and immigration ahead of the District 22 congressional election.

items.t: Man arrested after shots fired in Charlotte County road rage incident
items.x: A white SUV was left with bullet holes and a flat tire after a Charlotte County road rage incident that ended in an arrest.

items.t: Suspects in alleged school shooting plot in Georgia had floor plan, had chosen a date, warrants say
items.x: Three people arrested over an alleged plot to carry out a shooting at a Georgia high school had gotten a floor plan of the school, according to arrest warrants.

items.t: Deputies raid five Lee County gaming arcades, make 10 arrests in illegal gambling operation
items.x: Lee County deputies raided five illegal gaming arcades, arresting 10 people and seizing cash, gold, homes and cars tied to gambling operations

items.t: Florida judge denies challenge to South Seas Resort rezoning, keeping approval in place
items.x: A Florida judge rejected a challenge to South Seas Resort rezoning, keeping Lee County's approval in place.

items.t: 'GOURD TIMES': Watch as sea otters go 'Pumpkin Dunkin' in a zoo's adorable Halloween tradition
items.x: These adorable sea otters are getting into the Halloween spirit with tiny pumpkin slam dunks. See the "otterly" adorable video of the "Pumpkin Dunkin'" contest

items.t: How the Iran war is raising mortgage costs for US homebuyers
items.x: The Federal Reserve decided Wednesday to keep interest rates unchanged, leaving mortgage rates above 7% and homebuyers facing higher monthly costs.

items.t: NFL players help build mobility ramp for veteran in need
items.x: NFL players and members of the Cincinnati Bengals teamed up with Operation Ramp It Up volunteers to help give one Cincinnati veteran a better quality of life.

items.t: Riverdale HS girls basketball coach on leave pending Lee County school district investigation
items.x: Riverdale High School girls' basketball coach Ryan Magiera is on administrative leave as the School District of Lee County conducts an investigation.

items.t: Florida ethics commission dismisses complaint against Lee County Sheriff Carmine Marceno
items.x: The Florida Commission on Ethics announced on Wednesday that no probable cause was found to believe that Lee County Sheriff Carmine Marceno accepted a gift or misused his position.

items.t: Judge orders 30-year prison sentence for key figure in Minnesota food fraud
items.x: A man who played a major role in defrauding a federal food program in Minnesota was sentenced Wednesday to 30 years in prison.
